name: driveflex-rentals
description: DriveFlex Rentals — Monorepo containing Express Backend, Next.js Web App, and React Native Mobile App

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/.next', '.next', {recursive: true})"
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/.next', '.next', {recursive: true})"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install
